G-STEM.md routes world-knowledge answerability with substantive distractors to flag rather than kill on the express ground that 'authentic HP items very often have globally-true keys ... normal test design, not a defect', and its calibration section names this unit's exact shape as the archetypal false positive - 'three options argue one way, one the other' counts as a structural tell 'only if a reader with NO domain knowledge would see the asymmetry from form alone', the over-fire that wrongly killed authentic las-b00-007 and hard negative las-b0-013 in the 2026-07-20 eval. On q2 the leak is weaker still, because the clause tested is a particular of an INVENTED 1798 ordinance for an invented parish that no real-world source supplies; three of four legs classify the 'an ordinance imposes controls' route as domain inference rather than form, and the one leg that invited escalation is outvoted by the certified opus-5 legs and by the contract's own warning about structural claims of this shape. Redesigning q1 would also be self-defeating: its key IS the institution's defining fact, so no distractor surgery removes the recall lean, and the two distractors a knowledgeable solver discards are the unit's two most instructive misconceptions. This is consistent with, not contrary to, the cure applied to elf-b14-003 q2, whose distractors ALSO self-destructed on form; no form-level self-destruct exists here.
